$description: Focus order (library plan wave 2, foundation focus-order): the dev overlay that numbers a page’s Tab stops in the order the keyboard reaches them (platform/dev/focus-order.js, ?focus-order). system/focus-order.css draws it.

focus-order-color.$description: Focus order overlay: the outline of each Tab stop, its number’s badge and the path between stops.

plenix.purpose: The focus-order overlay (a developer tool): its numbers and path.

focus-order-on-color.$description: Focus order overlay: the number on a badge.

plenix.purpose: The focus-order overlay: text on its badges.

focus-order-warning-color.$description: Focus order overlay: a stop reached out of reading order, or one with a positive tabindex.

plenix.purpose: The focus-order overlay: a stop out of order.

focus-order-warning-on-color.$description: Focus order overlay: the number on a warning badge.

plenix.purpose: The focus-order overlay: text on a warning badge.

focus-order-stroke-width.$description: Focus order overlay: the width of a stop’s outline and of the path.

focus-order-badge-size.$description: Focus order overlay: the size of a number’s badge, given as its radius (SVG r; 24px across). A size, not a corner (owner, dot-radius-names-34).

focus-order-font-family.$description: Focus order overlay: the font of the numbers.

focus-order-font-size.$description: Focus order overlay: the size of the numbers.

focus-order-font-weight.$description: Focus order overlay: the weight of the numbers.

focus-order-letter-spacing.$description: focus-order letter spacing: the label role's (docs/pds1 text roles; #122).

focus-order-line-height.$description: focus-order line height: the label role's (docs/pds1 text roles; #122).

focus-order-path-opacity.$description: Focus order overlay: the path between consecutive stops is drawn at this opacity, under the badges.
